_: Sources under .moon-data-cache/ that tools/gen-tiles.mjs and gen-maps.mjs read, with the SHA-256 the shipped assets were cut from (streamed, so a half-gigabyte source is not read into memory for a hash). gen-tiles refuses a source whose digest differs: a re-downloaded product that changed upstream would otherwise re-cut a set silently. Update a digest only together with the assets cut from it. Cut with sharp 0.35.4 (libvips): the resample kernel is the tool's, so a different sharp can move every tile's bytes and with them the set hash in the pathname.
